summary: PASS — Iter 20 fix confirmed. `onPDF()` on web now bypasses the expo-print stub and goes directly to `window.open('', '_blank')` + `document.write(html)` + `w.print()`. Live-clicked PDF button end-to-end for all three evaluation types (cytology-100, progesterone, cytology-flex) at http://localhost:3000 (mobile viewport 390x844). In every case a NEW BROWSER TAB opened and its DOM contained the full branded template — all 11 required substrings present, HTML sizes 8641–9241 bytes. Regression: WhatsApp button still opens a new tab (wa.me) without a red overlay, and Share button executes without error. Result screen (stage banner, Recommendation, Heat Timeline, Cell Counts, Patient card, Breeding Schedule) renders correctly.

Native path (Platform.OS !== 'web') unchanged — still uses Print.printToFileAsync + Sharing.shareAsync.
Toast 'Enable pop-ups to view/print the PDF' correctly wired to the printAsync-catch branch — good UX safety net for pop-up-blocked browsers.
generateHTML() unchanged; still produces valid branded A4 template for all three eval types.
